description: This file defines the ClaimExpenseDecorator class, which serves as a decorator around the ClaimExpense entity to provide additional methods for manipulating claim expenses and related claim requests within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set and retrieve claim requests, expense types, and formatted dates, utilizing services and traits for core functionalities.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the ClaimExpense entity, providing methods to manipulate claim requests, expense types, and date formatting, integrating with ClaimService and utilizing traits for authentication, ORM, and date-time utilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the decorator with a given ClaimExpense entity.

methods.name: setClaimRequestByRequestId
methods.description: Sets the claim request associated with the claim expense based on a request ID.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest entity by its ID using the claim service.

methods.name: getClaimService
methods.description: Returns the ClaimService instance used to perform claim-related operations.

methods.name: setExpenseTypeByExpenseTypeId
methods.description: Sets the expense type of the claim expense based on its ID.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of the claim expense in 'Y-m-d' format.
